messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: stan emacs mode
parts:
Hi!

I am on emacs 24.5 and have problems installing the stan-mode.

So, I can't get MELPA to work due to proxy problems nor does Cask work for me - are there other options to install the stan-mode?

Many thanks!

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: stan emacs mode
parts:
Hi Sebastian,

The easiest way is to first clone or download stan-mode: https://github.com/stan-dev/stan-mode.

Inside your .emacs file, add this:

(add-to-list 'load-path "<path-to-stan-mode>/stan-mode")
(require 'stan-mode)
(add-to-list 'auto-mode-alist '("\\.stan$" . stan-mode))

Note the first path has a stan-mode within the path. That's intended. From within the repo, the actual stan-mode emacs file is in stan-mode/stan-mode.el



Daniel
